intro: As you pass a narrow alleyway, a hooded figure leans out of the shadows.$It's a Scrafty — sagging skin-pants, shifty eyes, the works.
speaker: Sketchy Scrafty
introDialogue: Psst. Hey. Hey kid.$You look like you got some… growing pains on your team. I got somethin' for that.$Everyone's trying it. All the cool Pokémon. First taste's practically free.$…I gotta tell you it might stunt your growth. Legal thing. Whatever.
title: The Troubled Teen
description: The Scrafty jangles a vial of suspicious "medicine". It swears the stuff will make one of your middle-stage Pokémon stronger — in some ways. It was also legally required to mention the whole never-evolving-again thing.

1.label: Buy the "Medicine"
1.tooltip:
(-) Costs money. Halves 2 random stats, stops evolution forever, new attitude
(+) Doubles 2 random stats
1.selected: {{selectedPokemon}} snatches the vial and downs it before you can read the label…

2.label: Just Say No
2.selected: You hurry your team past the alley.$"Your loss, kid," the Scrafty mutters, sinking back into the shadows.

invalidSelection: The Scrafty shakes its head. "Nah. This stuff's for the awkward middle ones."
medicineTaken: {{pokemonName}} feels… different!$Its {{doubled1}} and {{doubled2}} surged — but its {{halved1}} and {{halved2}} withered!$It has a {{natureName}} attitude now. It doesn't feel like growing up anymore.
outro:
The alley is empty now.
Somewhere, a health class video is missing its villain.
